title: ORIAMI
official: ORal antibiotics In Acute Mesenteric Ischemia: a multicenter randomized
summary: Main objective: The primary objective is to assess the efficacy of oral antibiotics compared to placebo on reducing the rate of intestinal necrosis or death (composite primary outcome) in AMI patients within 30 days following the randomisation.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Adult patient aged 18 and less 90
2. AMI of arterial occlusive origin, defined by the combination of 1) Onset < 7 days of clinical, biological and/or radiological signs of acute intestinal injury in the territory of at least superior mesenteric ischemia, including right-side colitis, 2) significant vascular obstruction > 75% of the superior mesenteric artery, and 3) no alternative diagnosis
3. Admitted to the SURVI care network (Beaujon Hospital intensive care unit or SURVI, Bichat intensive care unit or vascular surgery department)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Other forms of mesenteric ischemia (chronic without acute manifestations, venous, non-occlusive, strangulation, aortic dissection)
2. Unable to give consent (under guardianship or curatorship)
3. Subject deprived of freedom, subject under a legal protective measure
4. Patient refusal to participate
5. Non-affiliation to a social security regimen or CMU
6. Patient under State Medical Aid
7. Pregnant or breastfeeding women
8. Participation in another clinical study involving investigational medicinal product or patient being in the exclusion period at the end of a previous study
9. Isolated left-side ischemic colitis
10. Mesenteric vascular lesion without small bowel injury or right colon
11. Not eligible for vascular or digestive surgery or intensive care (palliative context)
12. Indication for an emergency surgical intestinal resection at the admission to the SURVI care network
13. Indication for urgent systemic antibiotic treatment on admission (evidence of sepsis defined as a SOFA score of 2 or more associated with an infection)
14. Systemic or oral antibiotic therapy within 7 days before inclusion
15. Known hypersensitivity to the active substance /excipients
16. Contraindications to the investigational medicinal products (gentamicin, metronidazole)
